scoring_justification: Full homogenization recompute is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; the checker compares agent-reported calibrated fractions and predicted conductivities to paper gold values within allowable margins.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold calibrated parameters and predicted thermal conductivities for the four composites.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 5 and Section 4.2 calibration text (FH3‑Laborel, FH6‑Laborel, CSP‑Belayachi, CSB‑Belayachi).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper reported values: FH3 cracking 18% predicted 0.304; FH6 cracking 24% predicted 0.201; CSP coating 15% predicted 0.055; CSB cracking 3% predicted 0.159; model types as per retained models.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are direct readouts from the paper's own calibration/validation results, not invented.

outputs.description: List of calibration results for four lightweight earth composites. Each entry reports the composite name, model type (must be 'EB-2-2D' for FH3, FH6, CSB; 'EB-3-3D' for CSP), the calibrated cracking or coating percentage, and the predicted scalar effective thermal conductivity.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare the agent's reported predicted_lambda and calibrated_value to hidden reference values from the paper with appropriate tolerances. No additional output files are required.
